description: Job Description Intro As a Product Analyst in the Real Estate & Motors Analytics team, you are the data expert for product decisions across the RE and Motors domains. You ensure tracking is right, experiments are sound, and stakeholders have the data foundations they need to act independently. Working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business peers, you combine deep analytical expertise with a builder mindset — automating what can be automated, enabling what can be self-served, and owning the complex cases that need expert judgment. This is a limited 1-year contract position. Hybrid role, office in Berlin. You report to the Analytics Lead, Real Estate & Motors. Job requirements Who You Are You bring strong SQL skills and hands-on product analytics experience including tracking ownership, experimentation, and performance KPI analysis. You bring practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows and know when to automate vs. when to go deep. Agentic AI is your daily companion and you come with a proven track record of utilizing AI tooling to get annoying and valuable tasks done (big plus: Claude). You have personally defined tracking specs, coordinated their implementation across PM/SWE/DE, and verified them in production — not just configured existing tools. You've designed and evaluated A/B tests independently, not just read results. You understand statistical power, guardrail metrics, and when not to trust a result. You demonstrate an ownership mindset, strong prioritization, and clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable building data products for self-service — semantic layers, metrics definitions, reusable templates. Nice to have: advanced experimentation methods (CUPED, sequential testing, Bayesian approaches), exposure to Python, dbt, or modern analytics engineering tooling; experience in classifieds or marketplace platforms. Job responsibilities What You'll Do Own product analytics for RE and Motors squads: tracking definition, funnel analysis, KPI monitoring, and performance reporting across seeker experience, seeker monetization, seller experience and Motors product initiatives. Define event tracking specifications end-to-end — from schema design through coordination with PM, SWE, and DE to verification in production. Build automated checks that scale beyond manual QA. Lead A/B experimentation: design tests from hypothesis to readout, apply advanced methods (sequential testing, CUPED, interaction effects) where appropriate, and build self-service tooling and templates so product teams can run standard experiments independently. Contribute to the semantic layer and data model so RE&M data is self-queryable by stakeholders — reducing analyst bottlenecks for routine data access. Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters. Support forecasting, planning, and operational analytics initiatives across the RE&M domain. Own your backlog — prioritize with transparency, push back on low-value requests, and make trade-offs visible to stakeholders. Job benefits At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive. ✨ Flexibility Flexible working time (hybrid) 20 days “work from anywhere” Paid additional parental leave for both parents Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move) ❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones Annual company sports events Pension and life insurance 📚 Growth & Development Personal development budget Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career 🛍️ Perks & Everyday benefits Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts An attractive referral program Transportation allowance Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability. If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.
title: Product Analyst, Real Estate & Motors (d/f/m) 1-year fixed-term contract

description: We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps. Someone who is curious about why users behave the way they do, loves numbers, moves fast, and can turn a messy problem into a simple product experience. What You’ll Do Own product problems end-to-end, from identifying the opportunity to launching, measuring, and iterating on the solution. Dive into user behaviour, product data, funnels, cohorts, and metrics to understand what’s working and what isn’t. Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth and Operations to take ideas from a whiteboard to production. Design and run experiments, A/B tests and product iterations to improve engagement, retention, monetisation and overall user experience. Spend time understanding our users, their motivations, habits, pain points and what keeps them coming back. Break large, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable product initiatives . Track product metrics and build a strong understanding of what moves the needle and why . Bring new ideas to the table by studying consumer products, emerging trends and unconventional product experiences. Move quickly, test, learn, ship, and improve. What We’re Looking For 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, preferably at a high-growth consumer internet startup . Graduate from a Tier 1 institute with strong academic and analytical fundamentals. Someone who is comfortable with numbers, data and metrics . Strong understanding of product metrics, funnels, cohorts, retention and experimentation. Sharp problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous problems. High ownership and bias for action, you don't wait for perfect information to get started. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, designers and business teams. A natural curiosity about consumer behaviour, social products, entertainment and mobile-first experiences . Note: The FRND team works 6 days a week, with the 1st and 3rd Saturdays being working days . About FRND FRND is redefining the way people connect by building social products that are engaging, safe, inclusive, and fun. We’re a rapidly growing startup building for millions of users and solving unique challenges across social connection and entertainment. Our ambition is bold, and we're looking for people who want to build, experiment, and solve problems at scale. Why FRND? 🌍 Impact at Scale: Work on products and initiatives that impact millions of users across India and international markets. 🚀 High Ownership: Take on meaningful problems and have the freedom to drive them from idea to execution. 🧠 Learn with the Best: Work closely with founders, leaders, and high-performing teams while solving real business challenges. 💼 Rewarding Journey: Competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and growth that matches your impact. 🎉 Work Hard, Have Fun: We're serious about building great products, but we also believe in enjoying the journey along the way. 💡 Solve Interesting Problems: Work in an environment where curiosity, experimentation, and first-principles thinking are encouraged.

description: About Us Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together. Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. We have a direct and positive impact on the real estate, design, construction and maintenance of our 2000+ stores, distribution centers and headquarters . Target invests 75% of annual capital investment into Properties, and over half of the enterprise OpEx, leading to significant opportunity to impact outcomes for the business. We have an ambitious goal to launch hundreds of new stores over the next 10 years, with several hundred more remodels in stores, all driving new customers and incremental sales for Target. Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading-edge design, development, construction and preservation? Can you effectively balance the efficiencies of a large-design build company with the unique challenges and innovative solutions required by individual sites? Then take your place as a Product Manager on Target Properties Product team and help us make the most of Target’s physical footprint both in the U.S. and overseas. Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work. As a Product Manager – GSCL Maintenance Operations, you will own the day-to-day product management for the work delivered in partnership with the Target in India Product Engineering team. This is a unique opportunity to help modernize Target’s Global Supply Chain Asset Management as part of a multi-year transformation by moving from a highly customized legacy system to industry-standard, out-of-the-box Enterprise Asset Management capabilities for our Supply Chain Teams. The transformation will establish a more scalable and sustainable foundation for asset lifecycle visibility, standardized maintenance workflows, mobile execution, safety, workforce planning and scheduling, materials and inventory management, asset health, and predictive maintenance. This work will help reduce downtime, improve maintenance productivity, strengthen data quality and transparency, and enable better total-cost-of-ownership decisions across Target’s supply chain network. Over the next several years, the team will establish the new Asset Management foundation and launch and scale across the network to eventually enable advanced asset-health and predictive-maintenance capabilities. As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product. You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories & acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders. You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles. Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs. About You Four-year degree or equivalent experience 2+ years of product management and/or equivalent domain experience Experience working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas, UI discovery and development) Strong facilitation skills that guide groups towards productive outcomes while maintaining a positive and collaborative atmosphere Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams Curiosity with a passion for learning and contributing to a growth culture Product management experience in Asset Management/ Maintenance Management, or stores /properties experience preferred

Proficiency in French is essential to ensure effective communication within our team and with our clients. Applicants must demonstrate their ability to speak, read, and write in French at a professional level. _____________ SFEIR collecte vos données à caractère personnel afin de traiter votre candidature. description: Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future. Client Solution & Strategy Specialist (Institutional) Ebury Luxembourg - Office based We’re looking for an Institutional Client Solution & Strategy Strategist to fuel the growth of our Institutional Solutions business. This role is a unique opportunity to have an impact in helping expand Ebury’s fastest growing client segment and provide products and solutions to solve their treasury needs. The role reports to the MD Institutional. What You'll Do You will help to discover the biggest treasury problems and opportunities for private market participants like investment funds, LPs, and financing vehicles and their service providers being fund administrators, law firms, and auditors. You will solve these problems through technology, analytics, product and operations. You will define a product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning cross-functional teams and stakeholders towards a common goal. You will operate as part of a cross functional team including Engineering, Data, Sales, Risk, Operations and Dealing. You will identify high impact opportunities in FX, Derivatives, Interest income and regional growth. You will collaborate effectively with internal teams and clients & prospective clients to define requirements, epics, and user stories, ensuring alignment and successful product outcomes. You will maintain a strong understanding of the market and conduct competitor analysis for product offering, functionality, pricing to inform development of the product roadmap. You will develop and maintain a deep understanding of treasury management and legal technology workflows. What You'll Need Domain Understanding Experience with Treasury products such as FX derivatives, Interest rate derivatives, and cash management. Knowledge of financial markets technology stacks, for example: treasury management, asset management, banks or scale up fintechs. Familiar with Fintech Treasury Management Systems. Experience with cash management products and solutions such as money market funds, deposit optimisation, and cash pooling. Strong understanding of treasury management principles and experience with treasury management solutions. Product Management Excellence Multiple years of product building experience, either product or operations leader in a hands on role. Strong individual contributor, willing to get your hands dirty and build product yourself. Have built roadmaps for teams finding a path from uncertainty/chaos to clarity. Has experience of getting to grips with established systems and processes. And identifying the optimal improvements and the pathway. Has experience of building both in-house services and integrating with third party systems. Experience in developing and executing product strategies that involve financial systems or regulations. Leadership Flexible in approach and comfortable taking a hands-on approach and "rolling up your sleeves" when necessary. Enthusiastic about learning new skills to unblock yourself and your team. Analytically-minded, can clearly frame problems, articulate hypotheses and solutions, measure them and has used the tools to be able to do this. Capable of communicating well to a wide audience. Proven ability to translate financial requirements into product specifications. Why Ebury? An impressive product suite including Supplier Payment Finance with more innovative and cutting edge products. International development opportunities including attending global Dealing Boot Camps. Career development and progression: Some of our most experienced dealers with exceptional FX knowledge move into leadership and coaching positions. Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced Dealing Managers who are invested in your success. Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best. Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized. Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits. Central Luxembourg Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links. Click the ‘Apply’ Today and discover your potential at Ebury! You can also connect with me on LinkedIn - Gabriella Cheston About Us Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally. Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team. At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage. The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars. We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story. Important Security Notice For Job Applicants Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity. description: About Toast: Toast is driven by building the platform that helps merchants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. Who We Are The Branded Mobile App team builds Toast’s white-label mobile app product: an iOS and Android ordering app that restaurants launch under their own brand. It’s a core part of how our customers own their relationships with their most loyal guests. We’re expanding the app well past order-ahead. That means agentic features that help operators turn casual guests into regulars, new surfaces like reservations, and loyalty enhancements to drive repeat behavior. We operate like a startup within Toast: small team, fast iteration, close to the customer. We measure ourselves on real impact to guest frequency and operator revenue. About this roll* (Responsibilities) We’re looking for a high-performing Product Manager to own the Branded Mobile App. The ideal candidate is obsessed with understanding guest and operator needs, has a bar for craft in consumer mobile products, and thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment. If you like solving hard problems, working iteratively, and owning a high visibility product end to end, this role is for you. It’s a chance for a growing product leader to build on a strong foundation and shape how restaurants own their guest relationships at scale. Responsibilities include: Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Branded Mobile App: where the product goes, what we build next, and how it drives first-party sales and repeat guest behavior at scale. Ship agentic features that help operators grow guest frequency, moving new guests to repeat and casual guests to regulars. Expand the app into new surfaces and verticals, growing both the core use case and Toast’s addressable market. Partner with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success) to define and deliver high-impact features. Drive deep customer empathy through interviews, usability testing, analytics, and app store feedback to make sure we’re solving real problems for restaurants and their guests. Use data to set priorities and measure impact, holding the product to metrics like first-party order volume, guest retention, and loyalty engagement. Do you have the right ingredients*? Experience with consumer-facing mobile products (iOS/Android) Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive in fast-paced environments, balance short-term results with long-term vision, and embrace iteration. Strong ability to translate data into actionable insights and customer outcomes. A bar for design and product craft, with a real understanding of what makes a mobile experience great. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to inspire teams and stakeholders around a shared mission. description: At Workwize, we're helping IT teams to easily equip their remote and global teams with all necessary IT equipment. Our automated SaaS platform simplifies hardware deployment, management, and retrieval with fast, reliable deliveries in 100+ countries. With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we're solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives. Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide. LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands! About the Role Workwize has built a demand generation engine and proven the market is there. The next phase needs a different kind of owner: one who doubles down on what works, cuts what doesn't, and turns a working engine into compounding, predictable pipeline. The Demand Generation Lead owns paid and organic end to end, and is measured at the revenue pipeline level, not the lead level. The market is growing and our ambition is to lead it by setting the standard others follow. This person has already done this inside a company that scaled from roughly €10M to €60M+ ARR, so working across multiple channels, segments and messages at once is familiar ground rather than a first attempt. Within 12 months they have a full funnel engine running across diverse channels, segments and messages, with continuous optimisation built into how the team operates by default, a team they hired and can stand behind, and a clear before and after story with attribution they can put in front of the board. This person is the reason demand becomes something Workwize can forecast rather than hope for. Key Responsibilities Own paid and organic channels end to end, and own the number they produce: SQL output and Stage 2 pipeline contribution, not lead volume. Diagnose the engine honestly in the first month: what is running, what it costs, what it returns across every channel, segment and message. Ship quick wins immediately. Not a plan for quick wins, actual changes already live while the longer term structure is being built. Audit website performance end to end, including landing pages, conversion optimisation and site structure, and turn it into actionable steps that lift both traffic volume and high quality lead flow. Maintain the 10% month over month growth in Stage 2 pipeline value already running on paid and organic, while building the segmentation and testing structure underneath it. Build a testing and experimentation cadence across paid and organic with hypotheses, owners and review dates, replacing ad hoc campaigns. Launch new channels and messaging tracks, get real data out of them, and make scale or kill decisions on evidence rather than instinct. Work with Product Marketing to make sure every ICP segment is addressed accurately across channels and campaigns, and keep Sales and CSM close rather than at arm's length. Assess the existing paid specialist and content resources against the bar this role sets, and make at least one hiring or team upgrade decision they can defend. Build and lead the team that runs the engine, with optimisation treated as a weekly discipline rather than a project that ships once. Required Skills & Experience Has operated at this scale. Has run demand generation inside a company that scaled from roughly €10M ARR to €60M or more, where multi segment, multi channel, multi message work was the norm. Full funnel thinker. Connects every channel decision to Stage 2 pipeline and revenue, not just top of funnel volume. Structured experimenter. Runs tests with a real hypothesis and a review date, and kills what does not work fast. Bias to action. Builds and ships alongside diagnosis, and does not wait for a finished strategy document before doing anything. Continuous optimiser. Treats optimisation as an ongoing discipline built into every week, not a one time project that gets shipped and forgotten. Decides on data. Makes scale and kill calls on evidence, and moves without waiting for certainty. Cross functional operator. Works naturally with Sales, CSM, Product Marketing and Brand, and does not build in a silo. Talent evaluator. Has hired specialists before and can tell the difference between someone who executes and someone who just sounds good in an interview. Owns paid and organic personally. Deep enough in both to challenge an agency, rebuild a campaign or fix a landing page when that is the fastest path. Workwize Offers Competitive salary, bonus structure and equity package. Flexible hybrid work environment. Top-notch tools and equipment provided. Vibrant, entrepreneurial culture with opportunities for growth. Off-sites and multi-yearly team bonding events. Team lunches and surprise events to keep things fun. Pension scheme. Classpass corporate membership. Our Team Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we will contribute to the change in the way of working. For us it is also important that we make an impact on our employees, that they feel challenged and ease. We consist of a rapid growing and ambitious team with all different backgrounds. Entrepreneurs, Operational specialists, Developers, Sales gurus you can find them all at Workwize and are always on the look-out for the next original ideas to reach more consumers and create the best value for our customers. We are looking forward to meeting you and discover if there is a match with the Workwize team!

description: MISSION Retail Investors across the world are ready to build wealth, but lack research & advice they can trust. StockGro is fixing that. As India's leading stock market advisory and research platform, StockGro connect 35M+ users with 150+ SEBI-registered experts and our proprietary Stoxo AI. On our platform, users access research-backed trade ideas and turn complex stock market data into simple, actionable insights; facilitating research, backtesting and trade execution on one platform. We are also expanding our intelligent investing infrastructure across GCC, starting with the UAE. We were featured among CB Insights Top 100 Fintechs globally (2023) and highlighted by the World Economic Forum (2026) for driving financial inclusion through AI (2026). ABOUT STOCKGRO Founded in 2020 by Ajay Lakhotia (former VC and seasoned entrepreneur), StockGro set out to solve a fundamental gap: making trusted, high-quality investment advice accessible to everyone. Today, we are India's largest stock market advisory and research platform, empowering over 35 million users to invest smartly. Backed by Global Leaders We have raised ~$110M from marquee investors including BITKRAFT Ventures, General Catalyst, SBI Investments (Japan), and Roots Ventures, with early backing from angels like Kunal Shah, Vivekananda Hallekere, and Rahul Garg. Driven by High-Density Talent Our team includes senior leaders from Sequoia, Swiggy, Glance, Airtel, and Uber, alongside alumni from ISB, the IIMs, and the NITs. Together, we are building an AI-powered investment intelligence stack and scaling our footprint across the GCC to make smart investments universally accessible. Why Join Us? You will work on hard, meaningful problems that help generations build wealth. We move fast, think clearly, and give you complete ownership to build products that transform lives for millions of global investors. Your role in our vison : We don't need someone who clutters a user's inbox with just another push notification or in-app prompt. We need someone whose messages get opened - because they're relevant, well-timed, and worth the user's attention. That means ensuring users actually understand what we're building, how our features work, and why this should be their go-to product for investing - not just that we told them it exists, but that they get it. This is a high-visibility role responsible for ensuring that users who activate on the platform stay engaged, deepen their relationship with us, and grow into high-value customers. What We Offer: We're a lean, close-knit team without rigid departmental walls. You'll have direct ownership over growth outcomes, not just a slice of a funnel. You'll work directly with the leadership on a product used by retail investors in India, with real autonomy to test and ship ideas fast. What You'll Own Growth & Experimentation Drive & own product adoption journeys through targeted channels once user cohorts are locked Lead data-backed user journey analysis and A/B testing and not assumptions or bias. Identify funnel drop-offs and opportunities for wins. Partner with product to surface high-intent traffic patterns and feedback that drive stickiness and retention Lifecycle & Automation Execute playbooks that activate users to new/existing features via in-app messaging, campaigns, and other communication channels as appropriate Design and build end-to-end lifecycle sequences for users at different stages - from Acquisition through Revenue - with messaging and formats that hit at the right moment Performance & Optimization Track and close loops on all triggered campaigns and automation workflows using rigorous metrics and data - not experimentation without measurement Turn funnel analysis into specific, actionable recommendations for the product team (not just reporting dashboards) Optimise spend and effectiveness across push, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and in-app prompts -with revenue metrics as the north star What You Bring Strong inclination towards capital markets - you understand trading behavior and how retail investors actually use these products. This matters more than years of experience. 4+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, product marketing, or similar Hands-on experience analyzing funnels, user journeys, and turning data into action Proficiency with CRM/marketing automation tools - WebEngage, MoEngage, CleverTap, or similar A sharp analytical mindset paired with genuine creative instincts Comfort with ambiguity and ownership in a lean, fast-moving team

description: About us At ablefy, we believe passion can turn into a career for anyone. With ablefy.io, we give coaches, consultants, creators, and entrepreneurs everything they need to build and sell digital products online — simply and efficiently. 70,000+ entrepreneurs already trust us to power their business. Born in 2015, ablefy has grown into a true all-in-one solution — courses, memberships, payments, e-ticketing, and more. We take care of the hard stuff, so our users can focus on what truly matters: growing their business. Today we're the #1 platform for coaches and creators in the DACH region — and we're not slowing down. That's where you come in. Our mission; to build software that empowers everyone to start, run and grow a successful digital business - borderless, is supported by our high performance principles that are crucial to our success: Radical Collaboration Constructive confrontation Adaptive execution Collective ambition Evolving expertise Empathetic leadership About the role Data is at the core of how we build products at ablefy — not only to guide our own decisions, but also as a value we deliver to our customers. As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping both our internal analytics and the customer-facing data products we bring to market. This includes delivering business-critical insights and reports, working on our AI-powered self-service analytics agent and the intelligence layer that powers agentic, data-driven product recommendations for our customers. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to define priorities and deliver end-to-end data projects. You will also stay close to customer needs and feedback to shape impactful data products — ensuring that data and AI-driven insights deliver maximum impact. Responsibilities Take responsibility for key analytics initiatives across the business, owning projects end-to-end and ensuring insights are translated into decisions. Own parts of our analytics engineering layer: design and build the data models and transformations that prepare and clean data for reliable consumption by dashboards, tools, and AI agents. Contribute to the ongoing development of our data warehouse — integrating new data sources and ensuring scalable, consistent metrics across the company. Work closely with internal teams to understand business and customer workflows, challenges & goals, and translate these into meaningful analytics solutions. Design and build customer-facing data products — from embedded dashboards and reports to AI-based self-service analytics tools and our intelligence layer — empowering internal stakeholders and our customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions more efficiently. Collaborate with senior leadership and stakeholders to define and track KPIs, assess opportunities, and prioritize projects with the largest impact. Qualifications Strong quantitative background and 3-5 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst. Exposure to AI-driven analytics products or LLM applications (e.g. self-service analytics agents, chatbots and dashboarding tools). Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn are essential. Experience with product and business event tracking — including defining business events, understanding product flows, and identifying the signals that drive meaningful analytics. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and an interest in applying them to build and iterate on data pipelines, models, and analytics products more efficiently. Great knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data warehouse concepts. Proficiency in Python for analytics and statistics. Experience building or contributing to customer-facing data products is a plus (embedded analytics, data APIs, or AI-based self-service tools). Strong communication skills and commercial awareness — able to simplify complex insights, prioritize based on customer and business impact, and manage diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering and Finance. Experience in fintech domains — such as payments, PSPs and checkout is a plus. Fluent in English; German is a plus. Benefits Paid time off – 30 vacation days. A competitive salary. A personal training and development budget of €1,500 per year. Responsibility and trust from day one. Individual coaching and further training to support you in your development. A free BVG ticket. Employee discounts at numerous companies (e.g. at the gym or in online stores). Pension program with company match up to 30% of employee contributions. A culture of equity and inclusion where you are appreciated for the person you are. Diversity & Inclusion At ablefy, we embrace our differences, as they are our greatest strength. We recognize that everyone has a unique perspective based on their experiences, identities, and thought processes, and we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. Discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or any other aspect that makes you unique is not tolerated at ablefy. We aim to make growth accessible to everyone! We know that no candidate checks every single box, and that’s okay! If you’re excited about this role and think you can bring something valuable to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’d love to hear from you! AI at ablefy As an AI-first company, we put intelligent technology at the heart of everything we do. AI is part of how we build, learn, and grow together. It helps us work smarter, move faster, and focus on creating real impact. We believe the strongest results come from combining thoughtful technology with curious, driven people — and we’re excited to shape what’s next, together.
